The prefix comparison \(F(\ell_i+t)=F(\ell_i)+F(i+t)-F(i)+O(m)\) has a shrinking argument (at most 3/4 of N), giving \(O((\log N)^2)\) discrepancy. Recurrence from the checked primary source permits an occurrence starting arbitrarily far right, whose descendants double up to its starting index; the resulting count exceeds the entire future removal budget, proving positive frequency. The exact deletion embedding of B_I in B_j^{2^{I-j}} has \(L=2^{I-j}(j+1)-I-1\) removals, so at most \(mL\) windows depart from the periodic template; the entropy bound tends to zero along \(m=2^{\lfloor j/2\rfloor}\). The verifier rechecked finite recurrences and embedding lengths without treating experiments as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The source's exponential Fibonacci language growth and its established marginal symbol frequency leave the measure-theoretic distribution largely undetermined. This result identifies a well-defined, fully supported invariant measure even though the word is not uniformly recurrent, proves effective factor-frequency convergence, and shows a concrete separation between strictly positive topological entropy \(\log_2\varphi\) and zero measure entropy. The zero-entropy mechanism is a structural vanishing-deletion-density estimate, not a mere isolated number or textbook rephrasing.
